overview: High school robotics team members tested their robots and conducted competition rounds. They also presented an award for outstanding robot synchronization to Team 547 Medfield.

items.title: Robotics Build and Testing
items.summary: Team members conducted robot testing and discussed their technical progress.

items.title: Double Elimination Competition Round
items.summary: Participants ran a double elimination competition round and noted significant performance improvements over the previous year.

items.title: Synchronization Award Presentation
items.summary: Team 547 Medfield was recognized with an award for outstanding robot synchronization.
